itemList.description:
Providing and laying of HDPE pipeline in KHB layout near Vivekanandanagar, Mandya city: Conduct GIS surveyand design of whole KHB layout (approx 16kms), Providing, laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of HDPE PE100 PN8 class for approximate length of about 8.55 Km and DI k-7 for a length of 105mts  including linking work  and encasing with DI  K-7 pipes where ever required  for distribution system along with supply, fixing and Commissioning of sluice valves and surface boxes. Construction of RCC valve chambers, pipe supports & Anchor/Thrust block whereever required including conditional assessment of existing OHT by carrying out-
a) Physical observations; b) Rebound Hammer test at random accessible regions; c) UPV test at random accessible regions; d) Working out appropriate restoration measures, if feasible; e) Submitting detailed report depicting out come of above studies; Work also includes earthwork excavation in all strata to the required depth, cutting of existing CC/Asphalt road surface, providing and filling of murrum/gravel soil around the pipes wherever necessary, refilling of pipeline trenches, Carting of excess soil and restoration of Road wherever asphalt/ CC dismantled for laying of pipeline/ valvechamber etc. Dismantling and Reconstruction of structures, construction of Concrete pavements and any other components required for technically completing the works as per specifications and system design criteria complete,  completing with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer Incharge (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7:Specifications, Special specifications for all the items)
